name: GTM Campaign (promos + email auto-replies)
description: Marketing and sales wire a launch: growth designs the offer and promotional angles, the email strategist builds the sequence AND the inbound auto-reply rules, content drafts the assets, sales builds the enablement layer, and analytics defines how success is measured. This is the 'marketing/sales wire product promotions and manage emails with auto-replies' pipeline. Roles pinned to marketing/sales agents; brain fallback chains editable from the dashboard.

steps.title: Design the offer & promo angles: {{product}}
steps.description: You own growth. For "{{product}}", design the launch offer and 2-3 distinct promotional angles: the core value proposition, the hook per angle, the target segment each speaks to, and one viral/referral loop worth testing. Rank the angles by expected leverage. Output as markdown.

steps.title: Email sequences + auto-reply rules: {{product}}
steps.description: Using the offer and promo angles provided, build the email system for "{{product}}": (1) the launch sequence — welcome, 2-3 nurture emails, launch-day, and a win-back — each with subject line and body; (2) the AUTO-REPLY rules for inbound — new-signup autoresponder, pricing/FAQ auto-answers, support acknowledgement with SLA, and an escalation trigger for anything out of scope. Specify exactly how each would be wired into the marketing-automation stack (e.g. Mautic campaigns, segments, and trigger conditions) so ops can switch it on. Output as markdown with the assets drafted.
acceptance: Passes the unslop rules listed in `methods/content.md`

steps.title: Draft the campaign content: {{product}}
steps.description: Using the offer and the email system provided, draft the public-facing campaign content for "{{product}}": the landing page copy (hero, benefits, social proof, CTA), 3 social posts per channel for launch week, and the SEO title + meta description. Keep the voice consistent with the promo angles. Output as markdown.
acceptance: Passes the unslop rules listed in `methods/content.md`

steps.title: Sales enablement & outreach: {{product}}
steps.description: Using the offer and content provided, build the sales layer for "{{product}}": the one-line pitch, an objection-handling table, a tiered pricing recommendation with rationale, and a 3-touch outbound sequence to the top target segment that stays consistent with the marketing promos. Output as markdown.
acceptance: Passes the unslop rules listed in `methods/content.md`

steps.title: Define success metrics & tracking: {{product}}
steps.description: Take the full campaign (offer, email system, content, sales enablement) provided and define how we'll know it worked: the funnel metrics and targets at each stage, the events/UTMs to instrument, the auto-reply response-rate and SLA metrics to watch, and a simple weekly dashboard spec. Name the ONE metric that decides success. Output as markdown.
